quotes.text: Sit on the end of an exercise bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Rest the weights on their ends on your thighs.

quotes.text: Sit on the end of a bench with the dumbbells resting on your thighs
quotes.closest: Sit on the end of a bench with the dumbbells resting on your thighs

quotes.text: Select a pair of dumbbells and place them on your thighs as you sit on the bench.

quotes.text: Lie back and use your legs to help you lift the weights.

quotes.text: Sit back on the bench, and use your thighs to help lift the dumbbells to shoulder height.

quotes.text: Lean back into a supine position on the bench while positioning your hands and dumbbells over your shoulders.

quotes.text: At the of your set, either lower the weights to the floor or, with your arms bent, just sit back up and return to your starting position. Alternatively, if you have spotters nearby, allow them to take the weights from you.
